title: Not a sprayer
text: Not a sprayer. First of all, l found the top spray part difficult to attach to the bottle. Secondly, it does not spray, it squirts a stream. There is no way to adjust from a stream to spray or mist. Thirdly, the plastic tube that extends to the bottom of the bottle is too long and curls up at the bottom. l guess l could pull it out and cut the length but since it doesn't function as a spray or mist l am not going to bother.

product_metadata.title: Olive Oil Sprayer Bottle, Oil Sprayer Dispenser Bottle for Grilling Cooking, 7 oz / 210 ml Food Grade PET BPA Free Olive Oil Sprayer Mister for BBQ Roasting Salad Baking
features: 【Food Grade Materials】Our olive oil sprayer is made of food grade PET material,Light weight, not easy to break, does not contain BPA, it is very easy to clean and healthier.

【Multipurpose Kitchenware】You can put olive oil,canola oil, vegetable oil and vinegar into Olive Oil Spray bottle.You can use it on air fryer, stovetop.And widely used for salad making, Cooking,Baking, Roasting, Grilling, Frying, BBQ .
【Effective Control of Oil Flow】Ergonomically designed anti-slip pressing handle, no need to pressurize, fan-shaped atomizing nozzle, evenly control oil,less calorie, enjoy low fat healthy life.

【Easy To Clean】Our olive oil sprayer uses a middle opening, no need to fill the funnel, just unscrew the middle connecting part, add some hot water and a mild detergent, mix it 5 -8 times, you can almost get a new oil bottle.
【TIPS】 Suggest wiping the nozzle after each use to prevent any clogging. There is a specific spot to open the bottle and close it up! Try Harder!
description: 1.) To ensure a fine mist, don't fill it too much or too thick oil, Then press the fuel injection handle, if the handle does not rebound and reset in time, please shake it to the left and right to recover. 2.) The best way to spray is hold the spray with 45 degree, press the middle of the button instead of the edge. That way can help you get a better spray. 3.) As the oil is easy to solidify(especially winter), it may clogged the tip, cause the sprayer spray a stream. Just run the nozzle under warm water for a few seconds, It will return to normal.

Our oil sprayer can be filled with oil, sunflower oil, olive oil, vinegar, soy sauce, lemon juice, lime juice, cooking wine, sherry wine, water and so on. Perfect for spraying when you are roasting, sauteing, baking, cooking, frying,making salad, barbecue, picnic, party, grilling etc.

1. Add some warm water and Dishwashing liquid into the oil dispenser. 2. just unscrew the middle connecting part. 3. Shake the bottle then spray out the water about 6-10 times. 4. Refill clean water and spray it for 6-8 times. 5.Air dry it.
Material: food grade PET material. Size (Approx) : 8.3*3.5*2.6inch Capacity: 210 ml/7.4 ounces Package includes: 1 x Oil Sprayer
NOTE: There is a specific spot to open the bottle and close it up! Try Harder!
